title: Extend Semio Ui Components For Iframe And Create Scene And Design Components
description: Extend Semio Ui Components For Iframe And Create Scene And Design Components
summary: Extended @semio/ui with iframe-compatible SemioScene (3D) and SemioDesign (split view) components. Added three, @react-three/fiber, @react-three/drei as dependencies. SemioScene renders a design's pieces as positioned boxes using plane data with React Three Fiber Canvas. SemioDesign combines Scene (left) and Diagram (right) in a CSS grid split view. Created storybook stories for Scene (5 variants) and Design (5 variants). Zero TypeScript errors. All tests pass.
